name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key. Created by AI under the directions of the maintainer.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.244: A stop now also rewrites the worker row of the direction it cancels. Until now the
    pending fire was dropped correctly, but the row kept reading "defer" with the previous evening's
    detail, because only a run ever wrote it - measured on prod: fire cancelled at 01:34, lamp still
    yellow on defer from the night before. The row now says "cancel" (yellow, same colour: the work did
    not happen), carries the moment of the cancellation and the detail "fire cancelled - stopped by
    operator". Upload and download are handled independently, a stop without a pending fire changes
    nothing, and a row that cannot be written never makes the stop fail.
